info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Invalid Emails API

params.name: start_time
params.description: Refers start of the time range in unix timestamp when an invalid email was created (inclusive).

params.name: end_time
params.description: Refers end of the time range in unix timestamp when an invalid email was created (inclusive).

params.name: limit
params.description: `limit` sets the page size, i.e. maximum number of items from the list to be returned for a single API request. If omitted, the default page size is used. The maximum page size for this endpoint is 500 items per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items in the list to skip over before starting to retrieve the items for the requested page. The default `offset` of `0` represents the beginning of the list, i.e. the start of the first page. To request the second page of the list, set the `offset` to the page size as determined by `limit`. Use multiples of the page size as your `offset` to request further consecutive pages. E.g. assume your page size is set to `10`. An `offset` of `10` requests the second page, an `offset` of `20` requests the third page and so on, provided there are sufficiently many items in your list.

params.name: email
params.description: This parameter allows you to filter results by email address. Only invalid addresses matching an address passed in this parameter will be returned.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a paginated list of all invalid email addresses.**

You can use the `limit` query parameter to set the page size. If your list contains more items than the page size permits, you can make multiple requests. Use the `offset` query parameter to control the position in the list from which to start retrieving additional items.

**This endpoint allows you to remove email addresses from your invalid email address list.**

There are two options for deleting invalid email addresses: 

1) You can delete all invalid email addresses by setting `delete_all` to true in the request body.
2) You can delete some invalid email addresses by specifying certain addresses in an array in the request body.

params.name: email
params.description: The specific email address of the invalid email entry that you want to retrieve.

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to retrieve a specific invalid email addresses.**
